changelog:
Version 8.2.5

New

  • Images tab: "Recompress original JPEGs" makes your original JPEG files smaller in place - same name, same address, same size on screen - only when the difference cannot be seen. Originals are backed up and can be restored in one click.

Fixed

  • "Recompress in place" for a single image now applies the same quality checks to JPEGs.
  • The browser-side compressor no longer reports "no images" on sites where it can work, and steps aside where the server already makes AVIF copies.
  • Spacing above Save Settings on the Images tab.
